mapper.select: SELECT menu_cd AS menuCd, menu_nm AS menuNm, parent_menu_cd AS parentMenuCd, route_path AS routePath, menu_type AS menuType, sort_order AS sortOrder, use_yn AS useYn FROM menu_mst WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, menu_cd

SELECT m.menu_cd AS menuCd, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, m.parent_menu_cd AS parentMenuCd, m.route_path AS routePath, m.menu_type AS menuType, m.sort_order AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN m.menu_type = 'L' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canView, CASE WHEN m.menu_type = 'L' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canCreate, CASE WHEN m.menu_type = 'L' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canUpdate, CASE WHEN m.menu_type = 'L' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canDelete FROM menu_mst m WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_cd

SELECT m.menu_cd AS menuCd, m.menu_nm AS menuNm, m.parent_menu_cd AS parentMenuCd, m.route_path AS routePath, m.menu_type AS menuType, m.sort_order AS sortOrder, CASE WHEN uma.can_view = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canView, CASE WHEN uma.can_create = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canCreate, CASE WHEN uma.can_update = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canUpdate, CASE WHEN uma.can_delete = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS canDelete FROM menu_mst m LEFT JOIN user_menu_auth uma ON uma.menu_cd = m.menu_cd AND uma.user_idx = #{userIdx} WHERE m.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY m.sort_order, m.menu_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_menu_auth (user_idx, menu_cd, can_view, can_create, can_update, can_delete) VALUES (#{row.userIdx}, #{row.menuCd}, #{row.canView}, #{row.canCreate}, #{row.canUpdate}, #{row.canDelete})
mapper.select: SELECT user_idx FROM user_mst WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
